ICS UDC 621.798.147 : 666.171                          CHD 10Reaffirmed 20171. Scope- Lays down the requirements for glass bottles for packing of free flowing non-carbonated liquids like fruit juices and vegetable juices, squashes, cordials, syrups, vinegar, etc, which are very little or negligibly carbonated.
